facts.statement: The genus Eoptolamna was described by Kriwet, Klug, Canudo, and Cuenca-Bescos in 2008.
The type species of the genus Eoptolamna is the extinct species Eoptolamna eccentrolopha.
A second valid species, Eoptolamna supracretacea, was described by Guinot, Underwood, Cappetta, and Ward in 2013.
facts.quote: subdivision: †E. supracretacea Guinot, Underwood, Cappetta, & Ward, 2013

facts.statement: Fossils of Eoptolamna have been found in Europe and North Africa.
facts.quote: It contains two valid species, E. eccentrolopha and E. supracretacea, which have been found in Europe and North Africa.

facts.statement: Eoptolamna lived from the Barremian to the Campanian stages, between 125.77 and 72.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Barremian to Campanian (125.77 to 72.2 million years ago)

facts.statement: The genus Eoptolamna belongs to the family Eoptolamnidae.
Eoptolamna is classified within the class Chondrichthyes.

rejected.statement: Eoptolamna is an extinct genus of mackerel sharks.
rejected.quote: Eoptolamna is an extinct genus of mackerel sharks
